text:
Maya: Quick async check — need to finalize prioritization for the "Payload Slim" launch. Two scope options: A) core token-level compression + compact response spec, B) A + streaming SDK changes. Share what you did yesterday / blockers / plan today. Target: reduce median inference latency ~10-15ms.

Jon: Yesterday: landed per-route latency metrics, noticed a regression in the batcher under 512-seq loads. Blocker: decision on SDK change — it adds ~1 day. Today: will finish canary config if we go with A.

Priya: Yesterday: reviewed prefix-cache PR, left one comment about invalidation edge cases. Blocker: waiting on design for compact header layout. Today: can pick up CR; if we cut scope I can include the SDK tweak.

Devon: QA: ran smoke on Dedicated; streaming tests flaked under burst. Blocker: acceptance criteria for partial/streamed responses unclear. My rec: drop streaming from MVP and validate compression first.

Luca: Design: updated compact payload spec and mock for migration banner (https://redwood.internal/s/payload-slim-spec). Prefer scope A to reduce surface area.

Maya: Sounds like consensus towards A. If no objections by EOD we’ll freeze scope. @Jon can you confirm canary timeline? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Jon: Canary timeline if A: start tomorrow 10:00 UTC, 4h ramp, 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Need the feature flag name and fallback policy.

Maya: Flag: `payload_slim_v1`. Fallback: auto-fallback to legacy when error rate > 1% or median latency > 2x baseline. I’ll post rollout doc in a bit.

Priya: I’ll own release notes and SDK changelog. Ping me on the CR and I’ll sweep docs. :white_check_mark:

Devon: I’ll prepare the canary test matrix and add a gating job check for 95p latency & error rate thresholds.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary job scheduled for 2026-03-18T10:00Z pending approvals.

Maya: Thanks — small follow-ups: @Luca add migration banner copy, @Jon DM me about fallback thresholds. Otherwise good to freeze. :thumbsup:
